comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
You’re getting this because this mod manipulates your spawn post-original spawn. This means there is a >50% chance you spawn right next to an already spawned PMC squad. I’ve gotten this a lot, however since I’m quite quick on my feet I’ve never been killed doing it. Like StvrScourge said, this most commonly happens with ABPS.

If it bothers you enough, I would suggest using the Use Last Exfil option, or disabling both options altogether. This is not something I can fix due to how this mod fundamentally works. Sorry!

This mod always causes me to spawn together with enemy PMCs. Is this normal?

comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
yeah, so it is the mod’s fault because of how it fundamentally works. it will teleport you when you spawn in. AI will usually spawn in at opposite areas from where you spawn, and this means that you’ll teleport into any area near/in direct contact with them.

unfortunately there’s no easy way for me to fix this. I’d have to patch the actual spawn function, and that’s not something I’ve done before. but no, it’s not on you. just the core functionality of the mod. ^^
